headline: Apple raises iCloud+ subscription prices in several countries
summary: The price hike for Apple's cloud storage service follows recent increases for other hardware and services, impacting users in various regions.
details: Apple has officially increased the subscription prices for its iCloud+ service across several countries. This move comes after the company recently adjusted pricing for various hardware products and other services globally.
While specific new pricing tiers and all affected regions were not immediately detailed, the change impacts users relying on iCloud+ for cloud storage, private relay, and other premium features.
caption:
Apple is raising iCloud+ subscription prices in multiple countries.

Apple has officially increased the subscription prices for its iCloud+ service across several countries. This move comes after the company recently adjusted pricing for various hardware products and other services globally.

While specific new pricing tiers and all affected regions were not immediately detailed, the change impacts users relying on iCloud+ for cloud storage, private relay, and other premium features.
